annotations.title: Preview who gets a product’s documents

description: Use this when the person wants to send a new data sheet version to their customers and first needs to see who would receive it. Shows who would receive the current documents of a product of the connected account: the confirmed recipients on its distribution list and the documents. It sends nothing and records nothing; sending is done with a button in the dashboard, and the tool returns that link. Do not use to actually send; this tool sends nothing and returns the dashboard link for sending.

language.description: Language of the answer: "de" (German, default), "en" (English) or "pl" (Polish). Product and account answers are written in German and English; content without a translation comes in German.

product_id.description: Product id, as list_my_products returns it
